data.name: AuthenticationRequired
data.value: The print system needs a user name and password that it accepts.

data.name: CertificateNotTrusted
data.value: The printer's certificate isn't trusted, so no encrypted connection was made to it.

data.name: PrinterNotFound
data.value: The requested printer was not found.

data.name: PrinterNotFoundWithId
data.value: No printer with the ID '{0}' was found.
data.comment: {0} is the printer ID that was requested.

data.name: PrintSystemUnavailable
data.value: No supported print system is available on this platform. Register a Latiprimere platform adapter for the current operating system.

data.name: VendorOptionKeyInvalid
data.value: The vendor option '{0}' must start with ipp:, cups: or windows:, followed by a name, such as ipp:print-quality.

data.name: StreamNotReadable
data.value: The document stream must be readable.
data.comment: Thrown when PrintContent is created from a stream that cannot be read.

data.name: PixelFormatNotSupported
data.value: The pixel format {0} isn't one this version of Latiprimere knows.

data.name: PageRangesNotInOrder
data.value: Page ranges must be in order and must not overlap, such as 1-3, 5, 8-9; these are not: {0}.

data.name: MediaSizeNotPositive
data.value: A custom paper size must be wider and taller than 0 mm; {0} x {1} mm is not.
data.comment: {0} and {1} are the width and height given.

data.name: IdentifyNotSupported
data.value: Printer '{0}' can't be asked to identify itself by this print system.
data.comment: {0} is the printer's ID. Thrown by IPrinter.IdentifyAsync's default implementation.

data.name: TestPageNotSupported
data.value: Printer '{0}' can't print a Latiprimere test page through this print system.
data.comment: {0} is the printer's ID. Thrown by IPrinter.PrintTestPageAsync's default implementation.
